Run away from places like this:
I have a 3-month-old puppy who arrived with my family just under a month ago. I spent TWO days calling this clinic without ever receiving a response, even though I left my contact information so they could call me back. After the tenth call, I finally received a response from a woman who didn't even let me explain the reason for my appointment. She immediately said, "I'll call you back as soon as I have time." I told her that I'd received a response after two days, so I NEEDED to be contacted as soon as possible, given the somewhat questionable start. Do you know how unprofessional and unsympathetic this comes off?
"If we start like this, I won't even wait for you, and you'll just look for another place." Kudos to her lack of manners, and hats off to anyone who has to put up with her—she's a total rude girl. I certainly do NOT recommend that place to anyone, not even for a call, if at first impact you find a PERSON like that, imagine the little EMPATHY he can have towards a PUPPY who can't tell him 4. I feel sorry for the owner of the clinic because I am sure (so I hope) that he is not aware of the rude person he has as a receptionist.

Excellent kindness and professionalism.
Thank you, Doctor!
Thanks Francesca have a good day
Angelo is the best vet there is, he loves animals and is honest

Dr. Marazzi's name is Angelo, and he is so in name and in nature. He has always helped everyone with love and professionalism, even those who didn't behave well towards him, and no one should dare say otherwise because he is the best! ANGELO IS ALL OF US, thank you so much.

We've been seeing Dr. Marazzi for two years. For simple, routine situations (ear infections, vaccinations, minor infections), we've always found him to be quite helpful.

Unfortunately, however, we recently had a terrible experience: our two-year-old dog had a foxtail in his paw. Instead of carrying out diagnostic tests such as an x-ray or ultrasound, an incision was immediately made to remove it, without any certainty that the foxtail had been completely removed. When I asked how to confirm its removal, the response was: "If he doesn't lick himself anymore, it means he's out."

We returned to the office at least three or four times because the dog continued to lick himself insistently, but we found ourselves faced with another colleague, who proved unpleasant, lacking empathy, and at times offensive. When I reported a hole still present near the carpal bone (the foxtail), I was dismissively told that "the dog is just spoiled."

Such unprofessional language and an attitude so far removed from what a veterinarian should be were deeply disappointing.

In the end, as the situation worsened, I only received an email that shrugged off all responsibility and urged me to consult a specialist clinic.

Today, my dog ​​still has problems with his paw, and I'm left feeling very disappointed.

🔴 I do not recommend this practice for serious or urgent clinical cases. For basic services, however, Dr. Marazzi's professionalism has proven to be excellent. But I no longer feel comfortable entrusting my dog's health to someone who is careless, hasty, and disrespectful towards both the animal and its owner.
Knowledgeable and sensitive. Lover of all animals and truly a charisma to be admired.
Thank you very much, Happy New Year!

I have two dogs and I could never trust anyone else. Dr. Angelo is a true professional: competent, attentive, and always available. He treats my four-legged friends with love and respect, immediately putting them at ease. Thanks to his experience, my dogs always receive the best care. I'm grateful to have found such a reliable veterinarian who is so passionate about his work. I highly recommend him to anyone who loves their pets!

Highly recommended!!! I had my dog ​​spayed and she's doing great. The next day, it didn't even look like she'd had the operation. Everyone was great, both in their organization and their availability. The prices were affordable and fair. Thank you!
My cats' vet for life. Very humane with animals and humans.
He is a serious professional, concrete, competent and friendly. Thank you.
